name: agent-handbook
description: A handbook you hand to your agent: teaching material for the general judgement calls — architecture decisions, planning, the rules that hold whatever is being built. Nothing here is tied to a language, a stack or a framework, and nothing installs a runtime, calls a network or needs hardware. Its subjects include `/target-world-walk`, which derives what a plan needs by replaying one concrete unit of work through the system you intend to have, instead of auditing the tickets you already wrote.
